belgian_pro_league.name: Belgian Pro League
belgian_pro_league.text: The biggest margin in the recent Belgian Pro League results was KVC Westerlo's 1-5 defeat to Royal Charleroi SC. There were two draws: Antwerp 2-2 Lommel SK and Club Brugge 1-1 Anderlecht.

bundesliga.name: Bundesliga
bundesliga.text: RB Leipzig's 5-2 win over FC Augsburg was the biggest margin of the recent Bundesliga results. SC Paderborn 07 and Eintracht Frankfurt played out a 2-2 draw, the only draw in the set.

concacaf_nations.name: Concacaf Nations League
concacaf_nations.text: Recent Concacaf Nations League results included goalless draws between Aruba and Martinique, and Curaçao and Panama. The biggest margin was Cayman Islands' 0-6 defeat to Guyana, while Bonaire also lost heavily 1-7 to Cuba.

eredivisie.name: Eredivisie
eredivisie.text: Heerenveen's 5-3 win over Feyenoord Rotterdam was the biggest margin among the recent Eredivisie results. Fortuna Sittard drew 2-2 with Telstar and FC Twente drew 2-2 with Ajax Amsterdam.

la_liga.name: La Liga
la_liga.text: Valencia CF's 0-3 defeat to Real Madrid CF was the biggest margin of the recent La Liga results. There were two draws: RCD Espanyol de Barcelona 0-0 RC Deportivo La Coruña and RC Celta de Vigo 0-0 Levante UD, while CA Osasuna and Athletic Club drew 1-1.

ligue_1.name: Ligue 1
ligue_1.text: Recent Ligue 1 results saw Stade Brestois 29 beat Olympique Lyonnais 2-0, the biggest margin of the round, while Le Havre AC lost 0-2 to FC Lorient and Angers SCO fell 0-2 to OGC Nice. Le Mans FC and AS Monaco FC drew 1-1, the only draw among the listed matches.

nations_league.name: UEFA Nations League
nations_league.text: Recent UEFA Nations League results included a 1-1 draw between Armenia and Cyprus, a 2-2 draw between Slovakia and Faroe Islands, and a 0-0 draw between Slovenia and Switzerland. The biggest margin was the Netherlands' 7-0 win over Greece.

premier_league.name: Premier League
premier_league.text: Nottingham Forest beat Manchester City 3-1, while Manchester United and Aston Villa played out a 4-4 draw. Fulham and Newcastle United also drew 1-1. The biggest margin of victory was Brighton & Hove Albion's 2-0 win over Brentford.

primeira_liga.name: Primeira Liga
primeira_liga.text: In the latest Primeira Liga round, Alverca and Casa Pia played out a 1-1 draw. The biggest margin of the results was Estrela's 2-3 loss to Benfica, while Sporting CP, Braga, C.D. Nacional, Gil Vicente and FC Porto all picked up wins.

serie_a.name: Serie A
serie_a.text: Torino drew 1-1 with Lecce, Napoli drew 1-1 with Lazio, and Fiorentina drew 2-2 with Juventus. Roma's 3-0 win over Sassuolo was the biggest margin of the recent Serie A results.

super_lig.name: Süper Lig
super_lig.text: Fenerbahce's 5-0 win at Çorum FK was the biggest margin of the recent Süper Lig round, while Galatasaray edged Amed SFK 4-3 and Besiktas beat Genclerbirligi 3-0. Eyupspor, Alanyaspor and Çorum FK all lost without scoring, and there were no draws in the listed results.
